p: and the staff: Because they trusted in their abundance and prosperity he shows that they should be taken from them.
the judge: The temporal governor and the minister.
eloquent orator: By these he means that God would take away everything that was of any value, and which they had any opportunity to want in themselves.
children to be their princes: Not only in age: but in manners, knowledge and strength.
oppressed: For lack of good regiment and order.

take hold of his brother of: He shows that this plague will be so horrible that contrary to the common manner of men, who by nature are ambitious, no one will be found able or willing to be their governor.
swear: Fear will cause him to forswear himself, rather than to take such a dangerous charge upon himself.
show of their countenance doth witness: When God examines their deed on which they now set an impudent face, he will find the mark of their impiety in their forehead.
Say ye to the righteous: You that are godly be assured that God will defend you in the midst of these troubles.

children are their oppressors: Because the wicked people were more addicted to their princes than to the commandments of God, he shows that he would give them such princes, by whom they would have no help, but that they would be manifest tokens of his wrath, because they would be fools and effeminate.
elders of his people: Meaning that the rulers and governors had destroyed his Church and not preserved it, according to their duty.
and grind the faces of the: That is, you show all cruelty against them.
Because the daughters of Zion are: He means the people because of the arrogancy and pride of their women who gave themselves to all wantonness and dissolution.
extended necks and: Which declared their pride.
wanton eyes: As a sign that they were not chaste.
mincing as they go: Which showed their wantonness.
tinkling with their feet: They delighted then in slippers that creaked or had little plates sewn on them which tinkled as they went.
veils: In rehearsing all these things particularly he shows the lightness and vanity of such as cannot be content with comely apparel according to their degree.
sword: Meaning that God will not only punish the women but their husbands who have permitted this dissoluteness and also the commonwealth which has not remedied it.
